themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints spiked to 8 THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 6,300% increase (z-score: 23.81)—suggesting either a coordinated poster campaign, enforcement gap, or emerging blight in Midwood/Ocean Parkway that demands immediate investigation.
evidence: 8 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
z-score of 23.81 indicates extremely rare statistical event
No prior spike pattern in 90-day data suggests sudden emergence
reporting_angles: Ground canvass: what surfaces (poles, walls, transit stops) are being targeted, and by whom?
Interview 311 intake staff and Sanitation enforcement to understand if this reflects actual increase or new complaint routing

themes_detail.label: Construction/Plumbing Crisis Accelerating
themes_detail.summary: General Construction and Plumbing complaints surged to 59 LAST WEEK vs. 12.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 363% spike (z-score: 8.75)—indicating either widespread building failures, unpermitted work, or contractor influx tied to active rezoning projects in the district.
evidence: 59 construction/plumbing complaints last week vs. 12.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (363% increase)
z-score of 8.75 indicates highly significant anomaly
19 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (11 alterations, 5 new buildings with existing elements) suggest active work
reporting_angles: Cross-reference recent permits (especially alteration work on Flatbush Ave, Nostrand Ave, Coney Island Ave) with complaint addresses to identify problematic contractors or buildings
Interview residents on affected blocks about plumbing outages, water pressure loss, or visible structural work

themes_detail.label: Encampment Spike in Midwood
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints jumped to 5 LAST WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 900% increase (z-score: 4.5)—marking a sudden emergence of street homelessness in this primarily residential district.
evidence: 5 encampment complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (900% increase)
z-score of 4.5 indicates statistically significant anomaly
No prior encampment spike in 90-day baseline suggests new phenomenon in Midwood
reporting_angles: Ground reporting: map encampment locations (Ocean Parkway, Midwood residential blocks) and document duration/size
Interview residents and local business owners about impacts; contact DSNY and NYPD to understand coordination on sweeps

themes_detail.label: Water System Stress 2 Weeks Ago
themes_detail.summary: Water system complaints peaked at 44 TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 16.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 161% spike (z-score: 3.99)—suggesting a burst main, infrastructure failure, or widespread service disruption that may still be affecting residents.
evidence: 44 water system complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 16.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (161% increase)
No recent follow-up data; unclear if issue has resolved
reporting_angles: Check DEP incident reports for main breaks or service advisories issued 2 weeks ago in Midwood/Ocean Parkway area
Interview residents about whether water pressure/quality issues persist; determine if spike has subsided this week

themes_detail.label: Sanitation Workforce Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Sanitation Worker or Vehicle complaints jumped to 6 TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 1.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 380% increase (z-score: 4.91)—suggesting service disruptions, vehicle breakdowns, or labor issues affecting garbage collection in the district.
evidence: 6 sanitation worker/vehicle complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (380% increase)
z-score of 4.91 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Pattern may be resolving; current status unclear from available data
reporting_angles: Contact DSNY to determine what caused the spike (vehicle fleet issues, staffing shortage, route changes) and current status
Interview residents about collection delays or missed pickups during that 2-week window
